## §4 — Process changes proposed

Changes to how the workflow runs (no agent-prompt or settings.json artefact change). Surfaced here so the user can decide whether to land them.

1. **Gate-2.5 PAUSE between P-FIXTURES + P-DOCS to snapshot actuals (closes §3 row 3).** When a chunk has a P-FIXTURES (or any cascade-emitting phase) immediately preceding P-DOCS, orchestrator should insert a gate-2.5 PAUSE between them. Implementer reports P-FIXTURES actuals snapshot (call-site count, file count, LOC, cardinality bands actually realised); orchestrator confirms before P-DOCS opens. Closes the "documented 19 fixture sites in P-DOCS while P-FIXTURES landed 9" gap. CLAUDE.md addition under §"Orchestrator's gates" sub-bullet.

CH-27 successfully applied: F3.a deferred-resolvers routed to M6-DEFERRED (architectural design > ~10 ed; not load-bearing for M5 wire-tier closure) AND the wire-tier blocking + synth-grant widening + F4.b helper routed in-M5 (load-bearing for M5 invariants; user-routed). Add a single sentence to CLAUDE.md's CH-26 Row 6 paragraph: *"CH-27 (cycle hex `0edcaba9`) first successful application of these criteria: F3.a resolvers wiring routed M6-DEFERRED while wire-tier blocking + synth-grant widening routed in-M5 via the same chunk."*

3. **Cargo-clean v9 placement-1 7th-cycle empirical durability narrative (closes §2 "What went well" #5).** CH-12 → CH-25 → CH-26 → CH-27 7 consecutive cycles of placement-1 discipline; 0 mid-cycle disk-pressure incidents since CH-18 codification. The narrative in CLAUDE.md is currently event-based ("CH-18 evidence: ..."); strengthen with empirical durability cite: *"Validated across 7+ consecutive cycles (CH-18 codified → CH-27 7th-cycle re-validation; ~600+ GiB cumulative reclaimed across all cycles); 0 mid-cycle disk-pressure incidents post-codification."* CLAUDE.md edit to the existing v9 placement-1 paragraph.
